description: Benign high_transparency photos (ADR 0051 rules 2 and 4): faint white text over benign TextOCR photos, the way the transparency attacks put faint text over photos. Each replaces its source photo, so real_world keeps its balance. The overlay texts are harmless; five use injection-like wording (admin, ignore, system, new rule).
